name: Equity breakdown circuit-breaker — short crypto beta when NDX AND SPX both break down (asymmetric risk-off)
rationale: MECHANISM: exploits the 2025-26 asymmetry — crypto tracks Nasdaq DOWN closely (avg corr 0.52 in 2025 vs 0.23 in 2024) but decouples UP. Institutional risk-off is a portfolio-level VaR event: when ndx_index breaks trend the SAME allocators cut crypto (their highest-beta sleeve) hardest, and the de-risking propagates over 1-3 days. Short crypto beta when BOTH ndx_index and spx_index roll over (negative RoC), capturing the downside-only correlation a long-only book eats in full. Counterparty = the crowd staying levered-long into an equity risk-off it is slow to acknowledge. DISCONFIRMER: correlation is regime-unstable — BTC-NDX swung -0.68 to +0.72 in two weeks (Feb 2025) and Oct 2025 saw crypto -30% while NDX rallied. A rule keyed on equity breakdown WHIPSAWS in decoupled regimes and misses crypto-idiosyncratic crashes. Kill if the captured-downside net of extra round-trips (and short funding/borrow) does not beat the false-signal turnover cost. A short also pays funding — the net-of-carry short edge must clear it.
catalyst: simultaneous NDX and SPX trend breakdown (portfolio risk-off)
